zh: 这个请求很紧急，客户今天就要答复。
en: This request is {urgent}; the client needs an answer today.

zh: 我们的截止日期非常紧。
en: We're working to a very {tight} deadline.

zh: 你能给我一个粗略的成本估计吗？
en: Can you give me a {rough|ballpark} estimate of the cost?

zh: 她非常可靠，答应的事总能做到。
en: She's very {reliable|dependable}; she always does what she promises.

zh: 我的工作时间比较灵活，所以可以晚点开始。
en: My working hours are quite {flexible}, so I can start late.

zh: 抱歉，我这周真的很忙。
en: Sorry, I'm really {busy|swamped} this week.

zh: 他是团队里级别最高的工程师。
en: He's the most {senior} engineer in the team.

zh: 你三点有空打个简短的电话吗？
en: Are you {available|free} for a quick call at three?

zh: 她就那次故障写了一份非常详细的报告。
en: She wrote a very {detailed|thorough} report on the outage.

zh: 我在家办公时工作效率高得多。
en: I'm much more {productive|efficient} when I work from home.

zh: 这张发票已经逾期两周了。
en: The invoice is two weeks {overdue|late}.

zh: 我有信心我们能按时完成。
en: I'm {confident|sure|certain} that we can finish on time.

zh: 这只是一份为期六个月的临时合同。
en: It's only a {temporary|short-term} contract for six months.

zh: 一年后，他们给了我一个长期正式的职位。
en: After a year, they offered me a {permanent} role.

zh: 请让你的邮件保持简短、专业。
en: Please keep your emails short and {professional}.

zh: 上线前的最后一个月压力真的很大。
en: The last month before go-live was really {stressful}.

zh: 你这一点说得有道理，我之前没想到。
en: That's a {fair|good|valid} point; I hadn't thought of that.

zh: 这是一份很有挑战性的工作，但我学到了很多。
en: It's a {challenging|demanding|tough} job, but I'm learning a lot.

zh: 公司重组时，有五十人被裁员了。
en: Fifty people were made {redundant} when the company restructured.

zh: 我很想承担更多的责任。
en: I'm {keen|eager} to take on more responsibility.
